text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing permitted parking for a maximum period of three hours on both sides of Falaise Road, between Kingston Road and Rodda Boulevard, be changed to prohibit parking from 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. on both sides. The proposed amendment will deter parking at this location and will improve vehicle movements by maintaining a clear passage for vehicles.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. on both sides of Falaise Road, between Kingston Road and Rodda Boulevard.
